verdict.rationale: Copilot is an agentic assistant: it acts in the browser, runs multi-step Cowork tasks and connects to real email, calendar and drive data, so a sandbox or test mode is a fair question for it. The evidence describes no sandbox, test environment or production-data isolation. It offers only step supervision and confirmation prompts for live actions, plus code execution for calculations, none of which is described as an isolated test environment.
